description: Use after create_proof, once you have signed the PSBT with your own wallet. Relays the signed proof transaction to the Bitcoin network. Send the record_id from create_proof plus either signed_psbt (base64 or hex, finalized or signed) or signed_tx_hex. The server checks it is exactly the transaction it composed and pays the exact service fee, then broadcasts and returns the txid. This spends the coins in the transaction and cannot be undone. Rate limit: 40 per hour per IP. You may also broadcast the signed hex yourself (e.g. mempool.space); the proof is valid either way.

signed_tx_hex.description: Fully signed raw transaction hex (alternative to signed_psbt).

name: broadcast
title: Broadcast a signed proof
